scope: Prepared primary Gemini/Vobiz opening handoff, immediate cached audio, same-session continuation and no repeated intro
confirmed_runtime_findings: The observed greeting was ready at 17:32:11, before answer at 17:32:18, under the outbound tracking ID.
Answer startup looked under the answered call ID and a single request-ID fallback, missing the tracking-ID bundle. Cold greeting recovery then ran from 17:32:20 until 17:32:28.
The same call logged greeting playback at 17:32:28 and 17:32:36. Immediate playback had not cleared the pickup-armed flag.
changes: Bind prepared tracking ID to returned carrier request ID and search all authorized answer/request/tracking IDs, including fast-answer races.
Send cached audio on authenticated/admitted media readiness before post-answer registry and lifecycle work; preserve the playback tracker across handoff.
Adopt the original connected Gemini adapter and record the externally delivered greeting without sending its audio twice.
Consume the greeting buffer atomically; clear pickup arming before playback and send one bounded silent opening-delivered note.
Prompt: continue after the opening; re-identify briefly only when asked who is calling, never replay the cached opening.
Reject missing/dead required prepared sessions instead of silently creating a cold replacement; cancel early playback and clean up unadopted sessions.
Record the prewarm/session-owner architecture in AGENTS.md.
